description: TY2026: MFJ, $90,000 wages, $8,000 SALT and $3,000 cash charity — but itemized (8,000 + (3,000-450 floor) = 10,550) loses to standard 32,200 + 2,000 SS 170(p), so the election keeps the NON-itemizer side and the SS 170(p) charity deduction stays ON. TI = 90,000-32,200-2,000 = 55,800 -> Tax Table $6,203 (same result as fixture 32, which has no SALT).
